headline: HEG Limited: Outcome of Board Meeting-Composite Scheme of Arrangement Effective Date and Record Date Notified
sum: HEG Limited's board approved the effective date and record date for a composite scheme of arrangement, following NCLT certification. The board also reconstituted its committees as mandated under the scheme.
implication: The board's adoption of the NCLT-certified composite scheme establishes the operative phase of the arrangement; partners should verify the record date against shareholder registry cutoffs and monitor subsidiary/related-party restructuring triggers under the scheme.
detail: On 24 August 2026, HEG's board held a meeting to formally notify the effective date and record date for a composite scheme of arrangement. The board took note of the certified copy of the Hon'ble NCLT order approving the scheme and reconstituted its committees to reflect the post-scheme structure. A composite scheme typically involves multiple entities or divisions and triggers downstream compliance including shareholder approvals, creditor notice requirements, and post-scheme realignment of statutory roles.
